description: Legal Metrology compliance rules applicable to cosmetic products, beauty products and toiletries.

rules.title: Veg/non-veg origin dot marking on soap, shampoo, toothpaste and toiletries
rules.requirement: Every package containing soap, shampoo, tooth paste and other cosmetics and toiletries must bear at the top of its principal display panel a red, or as the case may be brown, dot for products of non-vegetarian origin, and a green dot for products of vegetarian origin.
rules.applies_when: Applies to packages of soap, shampoo, toothpaste and other cosmetics/toiletries, effective 1 July 2014.

source.document: 8_viii__0__1__1732870622.pdf — G.S.R. 137, dated 16 June 2014 (LM(PC) Amendment Rules, 2014) [extract, pages 730-731]

rules.source_text: Every package containing soap, shampoos, tooth pastes and other cosmetics and toiletries shall bear at the top of its principal display panel a red or as the case may be, brown dot for products of non-vegetarian origin and a green dot for products of vegetarian origin.
